show.description: When Billionaire Ganavi Urs is forced to get married by her unwell Grandmother, she gets married. But After 1 year she decides to get divorce from her husband as she is not interested in the marriage, but the story takes unusual turns and makes her go through other difficulties, to know more about Ganavi's story watch The Billionaire's Lawyer show only on KUKU TV.
